paragraphs: Rav Shmuel and his brother R' Yosef, sons of Rava bar bar Hana. Rav Shmuel bar bar Hana, to Rav Yosef: Shabbat 29a, 59b, 146b. Rav Shmuel, son of Rabbah bar bar Hana, and Rav Yitzhak bar Rav Yehudah studied at Rabbah's house. Rav Kahana encountered them. Rava bar Ittai and R' Aha bar Huna said to him; see his entry. And Mar Yehudah, Rav Yosef, Rava.
